annotations.title: Remove a tool from my toolbox

description:
Removes one tool from your private toolbox. Destructive: the saved note for that tool is deleted (you can save the tool again). Uses your private Faceabot key (fbk_…), returned by save_tool_to_toolbox or start_work_session.
Example: {"key":"fbk_…","tool_id":"page.doc/pdf-extract"}

key.description: Your toolbox key (fbk_…). Omit on your first save.

name: remove_tool_from_toolbox
title: Remove a tool from my toolbox
